title: Hydrophobic modification of a polyurethane sponge via emulsion polymerization for selective oil–water separation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26372-26386
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01253A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Md. Ariful Islam Setu, Md. Rezaul Haque, Md. Suzon Ahmed, Ahmed B. M. Ibrahim, Muhammad Sarwar Hossain, Md. Kamrul Hasan
A polyurethane sponge (PU) modified by emulsion polymerization with PSt-co-PLMA coating showed enhanced hydrophobicity, absorbed 21–75 times its weight in oil, achieved 98.4% oil separation efficiency, and remained reusable after 15 cycles.
